info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v5-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Unsubscription API allows users to remove their subscriptions to weather alerts efficiently. This operation is essential for consumers who wish to manage their notification preferences and reduce unnecessary alerts. It typically serves individual users, businesses, or applications integrating weather data, ensuring they only receive relevant information. By streamlining the unsubscription process, the API helps enhance user experience and satisfaction.

delete.description: This operation allows users to unsubscribe from notifications related to alerts. Upon successful execution, users will no longer receive updates for the specified alerts.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to unsubscribe from alerts. It requires a JSON payload that contains the necessary parameters for the unsubscribe operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for unsubscribing from alerts in a notification system.

status.description: Indicates whether the unsubscribe operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the unsubscribe request.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result for this unsubscribe operation.

state.description: The current state of the unsubscribe operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the unsubscribe request, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the unsubscribe operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.description: Response schema for the unsubscribe operation via DELETE request.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the unsubscribe request.

createdAt.description: The Timestamp when the unsubscribe request was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the unsubscribe action was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the unsubscribe operation.

x-processing-time.description: The total time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates that the processing was instantaneous.
